name: Oz Comic-Con Perth
blurb: Perth's stop on the Oz Comic-Con circuit, a pop-culture weekend of comics, cosplay and gaming at the Perth Convention & Exhibition Centre.

editions.evidence: City page text: 'Oz Comic-Con will return to Perth in 2027! May 1 & 2 | PCEC'; the page's hours text calls the first day 'saturday', which matches 1 May 2027 falling on a Saturday.

notes: The dedicated guest page (ozcomiccon.com/perth-guests/) has no guest cards yet - it renders only the site's shared header/footer - so guests is 'none-yet' for this 2027 edition. 'PCEC' = Perth Convention & Exhibition Centre, confirmed from the hub site's own venue list.
